objective: Adapt H3 to reconstruct dense motion from the same sparse native temporal distributions used by densify.temporal while preserving known visual anchors on both sides of every gap.

required_task_code: derive a sparse retake video or native visual state from each dense target
inject retake_video and exact frame_regions_to_retake or equivalent native denoise masks into training inputs
preserve H3 17n+5 temporal legality and causal-VAE clip grouping
verify that known-token state is conditioned rather than included as a second noisy target
record the generated mask distribution in every sample manifest

upstream_baseline.note: DiffSynth exposes H3 Retake for inference and LoRA SFT separately, but does not publish a Retake training recipe; this project recipe is therefore not executable until its task adapter is implemented and tested.

dataset.target: dense clean 24 fps video on a legal 17n+5 H3 frame count
dataset.conditioning: a deterministic sparse version whose retained anchors exactly reproduce a declared CAUCE temporal-dilation profile
dataset.split_policy: split by source scene before producing sparse variants
dataset.audio_policy: do not optimize a production audio objective; keep the structural audio branch controlled and discard generated audio

required_before_training: unit-test the task adapter against current DiffSynth packed H3 shapes
overfit a two-sample fixture without anchor drift
measure one NF4 forward and backward pass at 480x832x124
record peak VRAM, host RAM, caches, checkpoints, and free disk
retain at least 25 GB free disk after the projected run

controls: base H3 densify.temporal without the adapter
decoded frame duplication at the same delivery fps

requires: pinned training commit and command receipt
ComfyUI adapter loading confirmed on the locked H3 runtime
